title: Features/494919 master mx cfdi rounding e invoice docs
summary: Mexican CFDI e-invoice generation now correctly calculates SubTotal and tax amounts by rounding line values individually before summing them, and validates rounding models locally before PAC submission to prevent validation errors.
key_points: SubTotal is recalculated as the sum of individually rounded line amounts to comply with CFDI40108 requirements
Total is recomputed after SubTotal adjustment to maintain consistency with CFDI40119 standards
A new local rounding model pre-validation process identifies the correct rounding approach before sending documents to the PAC
Fallback mechanism now intelligently selects alternative rounding models only when PAC rejects with rounding-specific errors
Retention lines are properly excluded from SubTotal calculations and comprehensive tests prevent future regressions
quote: The generated CFDI XML produced rounding mismatches in SubTotal and per-line tax amounts, causing PAC validation errors.
